question: Does a camera-calibrated 3D aperture have a positive door-plane closure signal that strictly separates real door leaves from no-portal distractors and large doorless openings?
single_change_from_pb10: Replace relative-depth and two-dimensional semantic closure with metric 3D relief relative to a fitted aperture-rim plane.

source.reason: The official bundle provides real RGB, depth, per-frame intrinsics, scene metadata, and dense 2D polygons including door labels.
source.license_boundary: Publicly downloadable research source with citation requirements; no independent open data license was located. Use only for internal non-commercial research and do not redistribute source media.

cohort_freeze.positive_admission: Official 2D polygon is labeled door; a door leaf rather than only a frame is visibly present; the source depth has enough valid pixels for the frozen score.
cohort_freeze.none_admission: No official door polygon and a pre-model human audit records no visible traversable door or large opening; freeze the strongest portal-shaped visual distractor as the aperture quadrilateral.
cohort_freeze.ood_admission: No official door polygon; a pre-model human audit records a doorless room/hall opening whose metric clear width is at least 1.5 m; freeze its aperture quadrilateral.
cohort_freeze.diversity: Use at least three SUN RGB-D sensor/source buckets and at most three frames from any one bucket.
sealed_before_output: RGB, depth, intrinsics, polygon and scene metadata SHA-256
capture sequence identity and sensor/source bucket
cohort_freeze.failure: If any denominator cannot be formed without relaxing these clauses, record NOT_EVALUABLE_SOURCE and do not run DepthART.

representation.aperture_coordinates: Map each frozen quadrilateral to a unit square only to define regions; all 3D points are back-projected from original pixels with the original K.
representation.rim: Outer 15 percent of normalized aperture width or height.
representation.interior: Remaining central 70 by 70 percent normalized aperture region.
representation.rim_plane: Unweighted total-least-squares plane fit to valid rim points in camera coordinates.
representation.expected_interior_depth: Intersect each valid interior camera ray with the fitted rim plane.
representation.rim_residual_ratio: Median absolute rim point-to-plane distance divided by median rim range.
representation.closure_score: exp(-rim_residual_ratio) * exp(-relief_q75). Higher means a planar closure at the aperture rather than free space behind its rim.
representation.evaluable: At least 60 percent valid rim pixels, at least 60 percent valid interior pixels, and a non-degenerate TLS plane.

P0_PRIVILEGED_SENSOR_DEPTH.input: Source RGB-D depth and source K
P0_PRIVILEGED_SENSOR_DEPTH.purpose: Test whether the geometric mechanism exists with measured depth.

C1_DEPTHART_METRIC.input: RGB plus the same source K
C1_DEPTHART_METRIC.author_contract: Indoor metric inference at lower-bound 640 by 480, preserving aspect ratio and scaling K with the image.
C1_DEPTHART_METRIC.license_boundary: No license file was found in the inspected source commit; internal research evaluation only, no redistribution or product claim.

metrics: balanced accuracy at the midpoint of the strict-separation gap when one exists

gate.privileged_mechanism: P0 evaluates 8/8 and min positive score is strictly greater than max control score.
gate.development_promotion: C1 evaluates 8/8 and independently satisfies the same strict ordering on the frozen cohort.

outcomes.P0_FAIL: Close metric rim-plane closure; do not run or tune C1.
outcomes.P0_PASS_C1_FAIL: Retain PRIVILEGED_SENSOR_CEILING_ONLY; change the metric-depth information source or collect paired data, not the scorer.
outcomes.P0_PASS_C1_PASS: Record a Development gate met and run one new source-disjoint K-known confirmation with the entire scorer and checkpoint frozen.

forbidden_rescue: After any output, do not change cohort rows, quadrilaterals, rim width, interior region, depth-validity clauses, plane fit, quantile, score, checkpoint, model size/domain, image resolution, K, or gate; do not add Trans4Trans, AISLab, RDAT ranking, morphology, crop variants, or thresholds on these pixels.
claim_boundary: PB11 is a current-frame metric door-plane closure experiment. Even a pass is not target ownership, public access, open/closed actuation state, traversability, active-view causality, temporal persistence, guidance, arrival, product benefit, user benefit, or safety evidence.
